fusions.name: End Over End
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Throws a hatchet at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Chopping Reel
fusions.desc: A spin that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Juggled Hatchets
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 20% for 10 seconds. For the first 6 seconds, an escort of hatchets strikes for 3 every 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Woodcutter's Cadence
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
